prospects.thesis: SMCI is the leading builder of AI-optimized server and liquid-cooled rack systems, sitting downstream of the GPU supply chain with direct leverage to hyperscaler capex. At just 0.7x sales with a $27B cap and +17.7% 1M momentum, the valuation has reset attractively while bullish options and institutional flows suggest re-rating potential as accounting overhangs fade. Entry now captures the setup ahead of holiday-quarter AI server shipments.

Intel's +43.7% 1M rip reflects renewed optimism around foundry milestones, government/strategic investment interest, and the 18A process ramp positioning it as a US-based alternative to TSMC. However, an 11.6x P/S at a $662B cap is stretched for a turnaround story, warranting a pullback before committing capital. Bullish options and institutional posture keep it firmly on the radar.

Qualcomm offers a reasonably valued (4.7x P/S) play on edge-AI, with Snapdragon X leadership in AI PCs and expanding automotive/IoT design wins diversifying away from handset cyclicality. The +22.5% 1M move is supported by bullish options and institutional accumulation, and the upcoming Snapdragon Summit is a near-term catalyst. Best risk/reward among the large-cap semis on this list.

GitLab's Duo AI-assisted DevSecOps platform is monetizing enterprise adoption of code-generation and agentic developer workflows, a distinct sub-niche from infrastructure AI names. At $8.1B cap and 7.7x sales with +15.4% 1M momentum, it's a growth-at-reasonable-price software AI play with bullish institutional flow. Q3 earnings and enterprise seat expansion are the near-term catalysts.

LHX is the contrarian defense pick — down 8.1% over the past month while peers rallied, creating an attractive entry into a prime with strong exposure to space systems, tactical comms, and munitions (Aerojet Rocketdyne). Bullish options positioning and institutional support suggest smart money views the pullback as overdone amid elevated 10Y yields pressuring the group. At 2.0x sales and $44.8B cap, valuation is undemanding for a top-tier defense integrator.
